Redlist

Red List. That minion may not attempt to block this action.

So, if I understand correctly, a titled sabbat vampire can play a Redlist ???

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Flournoy wrote:

> Nico wrote:
>>That doesn't seem realistic afaik what is the Red List (enemies of
>> the Camarilla)
>
> No more or less so than letting Camarilla vampires vote on a Crusade or
> letting all sects and clans vote on who should be the Ventrue Justicar.
> It's a game balance issue.

It's a design consideration, yes.

In VTES, the Red List is not a Camarilla tool.

It is a mark that designates that someone in a position of power
wants someone else eliminated. That's all. It has a great deal
over overlap with the pseudo-VTES-canon material (i.e., the
RPG source books :-), in that the same vampires marked for
destruction in one are marked for destruction in the other
and vice versa et cetera ad naseum. :-)

VTES as a card game. V:TM is a role playing game. They share source
